content.description: Initial content of the memory block.

system_prompt_amendment.description: System prompt amendment for agent mode that drives changes to the memory block.

injection_mode.description: Where memory content is injected. 'system_prompt' (default) adds it to the LLM system prompt; 'user_instruction' prepends it to the user message; 'agent_file' makes it only available as AGENTS.md in agent mode; 'agent_tool' exposes content lazily via the read_memory_block / update_memory_block tools (no pre-injection).

access_mode.description: Controls whether the LLM/agent can read the memory, write to it, or both.

max_content_length.description: Maximum number of characters allowed in memory content. Set to 0 for unlimited. In LLM mode, new memories are appended and oldest content is trimmed when this limit is exceeded.
